packet.comment: Read packet-beta or packet as the lowercase header. Only the shorter spelling requires the additional following boundary. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and packet.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows packet.md#ordered-rules and packet.md#hidden-forms.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows packet.md#hidden-forms.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows packet.md#comments-and-common-trivia.
Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows packet.md#composite-common-forms.
Read an unsigned integer and check its following boundary through directives. Follows packet.md#numbers-and-strings and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read quoted strings with backslash escapes. Follows packet.md#numbers-and-strings.
Read the range and relative operators and the label separator. Follows packet.md#ordered-rules.

packet-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows packet.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
